support-ana: heads up — customer is seeing a sustained ~10% 504 rate on hosted inference calls in eu1 starting ~2024-05-14T12:02Z after a cache rebuild. customer reports problems on long-lived streaming requests.
customer-jess: yep, we started seeing 504s right after the cache rebuild. only during streaming/open connections, short requests seem fine. retrying client-side makes it worse.
sre-ryan: can you paste a sample trace id and a curl/sample payload? are calls going through any edge routing overrides for that tenant?
customer-jess: trace: trace-0a1b2c3d, sample curl below. we also had an auth rotation earlier at 11:58 UTC.
customer-jess: ```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream -d '{"prompt":"hi","stream":true}'
```
support-ana: noting auth rotation + cache rebuild overlap. devops-bot alerted a connection window spike: ``ALERT env_monitor eu1: 504 spike 12:05-12:12 (50p increase)``
eng-alex: looking at edge logs — I see upstream RSTs with `HTTP/2 STREAM_RESET` and `connection window exceeded` around the same window. also saw server-side keepalive mismatch between rlb and midproxy.
eng-alex: suspect: rlb sticky session TTL (60s) vs midproxy keepalive/idletime (30s) -> client stays pinned but upstream conn is dropped and retries cause midproxy queueing -> 504.
liam: quick repro: with a few parallel streaming connections I can reproduce an early 504 after ~25s if I hammer retries.
liam: ```bash
# repro script (simplified)
for i in {1..50}; do \
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream &\\n  sleep 0.1
done
```
sre-ryan: thanks — actionable items: 1) temporary mitigation: increase upstream keepalive/idle timeout to 90s, 2) disable tenant-level sticky routing for affected tenant during rollout, 3) rollback cache rebuild if the above doesn't reduce 504s, 4) ask customer to add exponential backoff on client retries.
support-ana: sent customer a note with steps and asked for additional traces and client logs.
eng-alex: I'll push a canary change to increase keepalive (envoy config) and disable stickiness for tenant-id=acme-123, then monitor. config snippet: ```yaml
upstream:
  keepalive_timeout: 90s
  max_conns: 200
session_affinity: false  # tenant override during canary
```
devops-bot: scheduled canary deploy to eu1 at 12:40 UTC; alerting channel #eng-oncall if 504 > 3% for 5m.
sre-ryan: if canary doesn't improve, next step: rollback cache rebuild and re-run with staggered TTLs. also capture tcpdump from midproxy for the time window.
support-ana: customer confirmed they can pause heavy retries for 30m while we run the canary. asked them to forward client logs.
customer-jess: ok holding retries, sending client logs now. thanks for fast turnaround. :pray:
eng-alex: monitoring dashboards show drop from 12% -> 2% 504 after keepalive canary (prelim). will keep watch for 30m.
sre-ryan: leaving this open until logs + tcpdump analyzed, and we confirm root cause (stickiness + keepalive mismatch) - will update after post-canary audit.
support-ana: tagging this thread with tenant acme-123, will prepare a postmortem if we need one."
